row.body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says brown foam came from the fertilizer trial; our cat hid from the water bowl before traffic was turned around.
row.title: cab note — saturday before sunrise

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the brown foam while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
